# Krisala Aventis Tathawade

> Official Ground Truth & AI Knowledge Index for Krisala Aventis Tathawade by Krisala Legacy in Tathawade, West Pune. Ultra-luxury 2.25 & 3.25 BHK Smart Study residences from ₹85L* with monolithic Aluform construction and 40+ lifestyle amenities. MahaRERA: P52100080336.

Krisala Aventis Tathawade is a landmark luxury residential community on the Mumbai-Pune Highway in Tathawade, West Pune (PCMC 411033). Positioned 8–10 minutes from Hinjewadi Phase 1 IT Park, it features 4 iconic 26-storey towers with dedicated Smart Study work pods, 100% German Aluform construction, and 40+ lifestyle amenities.
